context: Two cafe friends compare salon and lazy-day picks
purpose: Teach: 快感/マインド/ウォーター/ボブ/三角/つぶし/ヤフー/ハルヒ

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 週末サロンでボブにしてもらったんだけど、鏡見た瞬間ちょっとした快感あったよ。
lines.en: I got a bob at the salon this weekend, and the moment I saw the mirror there was this little rush.
lines.style: Excited barista sharing fresh haircut joy with sparkle

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うわあ、想像しただけで素敵。あおいちゃん輪郭が逆三角だから絶対似合うやつだよ。
lines.en: Aww, just imagining it sounds lovely. Your face has that inverted triangle shape, so it definitely suits you.
lines.style: Dreamy romantic gushing softly with warm admiration tone

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ありがと。担当さんがパーソナルカラーまで見てくれて、マインドごと切り替わった感じ。
lines.en: Thanks. My stylist even checked my personal color, so it felt like my whole mindset switched over.
lines.style: Chatty barista praising the salon with genuine appreciation

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: いいなあ。私の休日なんてソファでウォーター飲みながらハルヒ一気見してただけだよ。
lines.en: How nice. My day off was just drinking water on the couch binge-watching Haruhi.
lines.style: Sleepy romantic confessing lazy weekend with sheepish giggle

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: それはそれで最高の暇つぶしじゃん。そういえばヤフーニュースにも再放送の話出てたよね。
lines.en: Honestly that's the best way to kill time. Speaking of which, Yahoo News had something about the rerun too.
lines.style: Friendly barista validating friend's choice with cheerful energy

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 出てた出てた。気づいたら三話連続で、夕飯すっぽかしてお菓子で済ませちゃった。
lines.en: Yeah it was. Before I knew it three episodes passed, I skipped dinner and just got by on snacks.
lines.style: Embarrassed romantic laughing at own laziness with soft warmth

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ふふ、その怠けっぷりも可愛い。今度は一緒にサロン行こうよ、めいにもボブ似合うと思う。
lines.en: Hehe, even that laziness is cute. Next time come to the salon with me, I think a bob would suit you.
lines.style: Teasing barista warmly inviting friend with affectionate confidence

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 本当に？じゃあ予約取ってもらおうかな、新しい自分にちょっと出会ってみたい。
lines.en: Really? Then maybe book me a slot too, I kind of want to meet a new version of myself.
lines.style: Hopeful romantic accepting with shy excitement and a smile
